title: Erdős #130 OQ-03: The Clique/Cardinality Sandwich for Chromatic Numbers of Integer-Distance Graphs
description: Two elementary but load-bearing facts sandwiching the open chromatic number χ(G(A)) of integer-distance graphs: χ ≥ ω (chromatic_ge_clique, pigeonhole on a clique) and χ ≤ |A| (chromatic_le_card, the distinct-colour colouring). Combined with the Anning–Erdős clique bound this locates χ in the window ω ≤ χ ≤ |A| ≤ 4(2D+1)(2E+1) for finite general-position sets (chromatic_finite). 0 axioms, 0 sorries.
